title: Rotation
description: Put a schedule on a secret, name an owner, and let the control plane generate and apply new values for secrets you mark auto-rotatable.

empty.title: No secrets to rotate
empty.description: Add a secret above first. Then give it a rotation policy here.

dialog.title: Rotation policy for {{key}}
dialog.description: Rotation never shows or logs the value.
dialog.graceHint: The previous value stays available as {{key}}_PREVIOUS until the window ends. Zero keeps nothing.
dialog.autoHint: Only for secrets this platform may replace with a random value. Leave off for credentials issued by someone else.
dialog.invalid: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 3650, and grace hours of 0 or more.

confirm.title: Rotate {{key}} now?
confirm.description: A new value is generated and the app restarts to pick it up.
confirm.consequenceRestart: The app is recreated through the normal health-gated cutover.
confirm.consequenceGrace: The old value is not shown anywhere. With a grace window it stays available as {{key}}_PREVIOUS.

rotateValue.title: Rotate {{key}}?
rotateValue.description: Write a new value now. The old value is kept as {{key}}_PREVIOUS for the grace window, then removed.
rotateValue.consequenceNoRestart: Running containers keep the old value until the app is redeployed.
rotateValue.consequenceAudit: The rotation is recorded in the audit log. The value is never shown or logged.
rotateValue.valueHint: Leave empty to generate a random value.

redeploy.title: {{key}} was rotated
redeploy.description: {{app}} still runs with the old value. Redeploy it to apply the new one.

vault.title: Rotate credential
vault.description: Replace the stored Vault token or AppRole secret ID. The old credential stays available for the grace window, then is removed.
vault.dialogDescription: Paste the new credential issued by Vault. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
vault.consequenceKeep: The previous credential is kept for the grace window.
vault.consequenceAudit: The rotation is recorded in the audit log.

overview.title: Secret rotations
overview.description: Every rotation policy across apps, with what is overdue or stuck listed first.
overview.empty: No rotation policies yet. Open an app's Environment page to add one.

buildTime.label: Build
buildTime.hint: Let this app's build read this secret via build.secrets. Anyone who can edit the Dockerfile can read it during the build.
buildTime.listHint: Enabled secrets can be read by builds through build.secrets

confirm.title: Let builds read {{key}}?
confirm.description: Any build of this app can read this secret through build.secrets. Anyone who can edit the Dockerfile can print it during the build, so enable it only for secrets the build truly needs.

toast.failed: Could not update build access for {{key}}: {{message}}
